clue.text: Press hard to separate the wall of defenders

parts.note: to ram is to push or press forcefully
to part is to divide or separate

explanation.surface: A rugby coach urges the forwards to push through and split the opposing defensive line.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampart is a broad defensive embankment, the protective barrier of a fortress.

clue.text: Display reorganized in Harrow, see

indicators.note: reorganized means the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A school exhibition is rearranged at Harrow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reorganized' rearranges HARROWSEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A raree-show is a peep show or street spectacle, a display.

clue.text: Many in Bucks town producing fur

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, many
taken as written
Iver is a village in Buckinghamshire

explanation.surface: Many in a Buckinghamshire town make fur garments.
explanation.walkthrough: Bucks is short for Buckinghamshire, an English county; Iver is a village there.
explanation.definitionFit: Miniver is a white fur used to trim ceremonial robes.

clue.text: It may be stored in bottles for safe-opening

definitions.text: It may be stored in bottles for safe-opening

parts.words: It may be stored in bottles for safe-opening
parts.note: a gas kept in cylinders and burnt in a cutting torch used by safe-crackers

explanation.walkthrough: 'Safe-opening' looks like 'opening safely'; it means breaking into a safe with an oxy-fuel cutting torch.
explanation.definitionFit: This gas, kept in cylinders, burns hot enough to cut through steel.

clue.text: This cup-bearer sounds very French

indicators.note: sounds signals that the French word is heard, not spelt

parts.note: tres is French for very

explanation.surface: A waiter carrying cups seems terribly French.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat board carries cups, so it bears them.

clue.text: King's visual aid in country of the blind

definitions.text: King's visual aid in country of the blind

parts.words: King's visual aid in country of the blind
parts.note: the proverb says that in the country of the blind the one-eyed man is king, so his eyepiece serves only one eye

explanation.walkthrough: The clue leans on the proverb 'in the country of the blind, the one-eyed man is king': the king's aid is a lens for a single eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A single eyeglass for one eye suits the one-eyed king of the proverb.

clue.text: Weep buckets perhaps, sadly

parts.note: to weep is to mourn
to weep buckets is to cry fully, in abundance

explanation.surface: Someone sobbing their heart out in sorrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Mournfully means sorrowfully, in a grieving way.

clue.text: Russian girl has the makings of a Moon Goddess

indicators.note: the makings of means the letters are raw material to be reassembled

parts.note: Diana is the Roman goddess of the moon

explanation.surface: A Russian girl shows potential to be a lunar deity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the makings of' rearranges DIANA.
explanation.definitionFit: Nadia is a common Russian female name.

clue.text: Lay hands on company following swindle

indicators.note: following means the company comes after the swindle

parts.note: a con is a swindle
a firm is a company

explanation.surface: Grabbing a business after cheating it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lay hands on' suggests grabbing; it is the bishop's laying-on of hands in the church rite.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop admits someone to full church membership by laying hands on them.

clue.text: Upright build

explanation.surface: A tall physique.
explanation.definitionFit: Vertical, and to put up a structure.

clue.text: This solution's a wash-out

parts.note: a liquid preparation used in hairdressing that is simply washed out, read in its literal sense rather than as a failure

explanation.walkthrough: 'Solution' suggests the answer to a puzzle and 'wash-out' a failure; both are literal: a liquid for washing out.
explanation.definitionFit: A hair colourant applied as a liquid and then washed away is this kind of solution.

clue.text: Nine plenty for this solo venture

definitions.text: Nine plenty for this solo venture

parts.words: Nine plenty for this solo venture
parts.note: in the card game solo whist, a player bidding to take nine tricks alone makes a bid whose name also means plenty

explanation.walkthrough: In solo whist (a card game) the bid to win nine tricks playing alone carries the same name as the word for plenty.
explanation.definitionFit: The word for a plentiful supply is also the solo whist bid of nine tricks.

clue.text: Poetical postscripts of diplomats

definitions.meaning: an envoi or envoy is the short closing stanza of a ballade
emissaries sent to represent a government abroad

explanation.surface: Ambassadors add little verses at the end of their dispatches.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: closing stanzas of poems, and ministers dispatched abroad as messengers.

clue.text: This recorder said to be heard by one lying on couch

indicators.note: said signals that the word heard is a sound-alike of the entry

parts.words: heard by one lying on couch
parts.note: the patient on the couch listens to the psychoanalyst

explanation.surface: A chronicler is mistaken for a psychotherapist by a patient reclining on the couch.
explanation.walkthrough: The psychoanalyst's patient traditionally lies on a couch; the therapist's title sounds like the chronicler's.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of yearly historical records is a chronicler, a recorder of events.

clue.text: Field Marshal in eight sounds soft

indicators.note: sounds means the letters and words are spoken aloud

parts.note: FM is the abbreviation for Field Marshal, said as the letter names, followed by in and eight

explanation.surface: A field marshal sounds weak within a rowing eight.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, F M IN EIGHT is 'eff em in ate'.
explanation.definitionFit: Effeminate means unmanly, delicate, a disparaging sense of soft.

clue.text: Rough sounding? Could be rough if it's white

definitions.text: Could be rough if it's white

indicators.note: sounding signals that the word for rough is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a rough, croaky voice is hoarse

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a voice that grates and something white that can be rough.
explanation.walkthrough: White horses are the foam-capped waves of a rough sea.
explanation.definitionFit: White horses are the crests of choppy waves, so a white one implies rough water.

clue.text: Quartets taking turns to play

definitions.meaning: in a golf foursome each pair plays one ball, partners hitting alternately

explanation.surface: Musical groups of four take it in turns to perform.
explanation.definitionFit: Groups of four, and golf matches where partners strike one ball alternately.

clue.text: No poltergeist among the spirits here

definitions.text: No poltergeist among the spirits here

parts.words: No poltergeist among the spirits here
parts.note: spirits are liquors kept in a quiet room, not ghosts, so nothing noisy haunts it

explanation.walkthrough: 'Spirits' suggests ghosts; they are distilled liquors in a household store-room for cordials and preserves.
explanation.definitionFit: A household store-room for liquors and preserves, its name hinting at quietness.

clue.text: It's racial miscegenation to be thus scornful about society

indicators.note: miscegenation means mixing, so the letters are mixed together

explanation.surface: Mixing of races provokes mocking social commentary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'miscegenation' rearranges ITSRACIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Satire mocks the follies of society, so satirical writing is scornful of it.

clue.text: Full breakfast may mean brown bread

parts.note: full means whole, complete
breakfast is a meal

explanation.surface: Ordering a full English breakfast may bring brown toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread baked from unrefined flour including the bran is brown.

clue.text: Time for some strong ale

definitions.meaning: a strong ale traditionally brewed in the autumn month

explanation.surface: A season for drinking powerful beer.
explanation.definitionFit: The tenth month, and the strong ale traditionally brewed then.

clue.text: Bumble's law being one

parts.note: Mr Bumble in Dickens's Oliver Twist declares 'the law is a ass

explanation.walkthrough: Mr Bumble, the beadle in Oliver Twist, says 'If the law supposes that, the law is a ass, a idiot.'
explanation.definitionFit: Mr Bumble calls the law a fool in exactly this word.

clue.text: Take cover from him if you value your life

definitions.text: Take cover from him if you value your life

parts.words: Take cover from him if you value your life
parts.note: taking out cover is buying a policy, and valuing a life is a life assurance policy

explanation.walkthrough: 'Take cover' sounds like hiding from danger; it means buying an insurance policy, and 'value your life' is life cover.
explanation.definitionFit: An underwriter provides policies, cover against loss including death.

clue.text: Oil catch freely, being liberal

indicators.note: freely means the letters are rearranged without restriction

explanation.surface: Grabbing oil without restraint, being generous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freely' rearranges OILCATCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Catholic in its lower-case sense means broad-minded, universal in sympathies.

clue.text: Encoded cable from Moses' spy

indicators.note: encoded means the letters are scrambled as in a cipher

explanation.surface: A coded cable from Moses' secret agent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Encoded' rearranges CABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Numbers, Caleb was one of the scouts Moses sent into Canaan.

clue.text: Branch of ACAS?

parts.note: ACAS is Britain's Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service, and the branch offered as a peace sign

explanation.walkthrough: ACAS is the UK's Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service, which settles industrial disputes; a peace offering is this kind of branch.
explanation.definitionFit: The branch symbolising peace and conciliation is the one ACAS might offer.

clue.text: Shutter at shorter range

explanation.surface: A camera shutter used for nearer shots.
explanation.definitionFit: One who shuts, and the comparative meaning nearer.

clue.text: Painted in Athens, so at variance with a philosopher

indicators.note: being at variance means differing, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An Athenian painting differs from a philosopher's view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variance' rearranges SOAT. The Painted Stoa (Stoa Poikile) in Athens gave its name to Zeno's Stoic school, hence 'with a philosopher'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stoa Poikile, or Painted Porch, was a colonnade in Athens where Zeno taught.

clue.text: In Greece we hear of this slippery agent

definitions.text: In Greece we hear of this slippery agent

parts.words: In Greece we hear of this slippery agent
parts.note: Greece is said like grease, and a slippery agent is what grease is used as

explanation.walkthrough: 'Greece we hear' is grease: something oily is in grease.
explanation.definitionFit: Grease is an oily substance reducing friction, a slippery agent.

clue.text: Elsinore fop "spacious in the possession of dirt"

definitions.meaning: the foppish courtier in Hamlet, set at Elsinore
Hamlet's description of the courtier as a rich landowner

explanation.surface: A dandy at the Danish court described as owning a great deal of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet's affected courtier at Elsinore, whom the prince mocks as rich in land.

clue.text: Such a girl called one back to Mandalay

definitions.text: Such a girl called one back to Mandalay

parts.words: Such a girl called one back to Mandalay
parts.note: in Kipling's poem Mandalay, a girl of that country calls the British soldier to come back

explanation.walkthrough: Kipling's 'Mandalay': 'There's a ... girl a-settin', and I know she thinks o' me... Come you back, you British soldier.'
explanation.definitionFit: Mandalay is in Myanmar, formerly Burma, so the girl in Kipling's poem is from there.

clue.text: Sailor, red or white if airborne

definitions.meaning: red and white are kinds of butterfly with this name

explanation.surface: A naval man described by the colours of his ensign.
explanation.definitionFit: A top naval commander, and the red and white butterflies.
